ksdd2.verification: Volume/article number and DOI checked online on 2026-09-19. Author list, title, journal and year come from the dataset provider's citation block (https://www.vicos.si/resources/kolektorsdd2/); the volume and page field were missing there and were completed from three independent records: the arXiv entry for the accepted version (https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.06064, Comments 'Accepted for publication in Computers in Industry', Related DOI https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compind.2021.103459), the publisher DOI landing page (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compind.2021.103459), and two citation records that both give 'Computers in Industry 129, 103459, 2021' (Google Scholar listing https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=sZpqYzAAAAAJ and an exaly citation report for the same DOI). This is the paper that introduces KolektorSDD2 - its abstract states 'we also present a new dataset termed KolektorSDD2' - and not the earlier KolektorSDD paper (Tabernik et al., J. Intell. Manuf., 2020), which this manuscript does not cite. Computers in Industry uses article numbers instead of page ranges, so 'Art. no. 103459' is the page field. The provider page records the licence as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and the counts used in Section 4.2.9 (train 246/2085, test 110/894).
